Lauren / Team,

Quick update after speaking with our broker and the carrier contacts:

- Addl Insured: Carrier can issue an Additional Insured endorsement (CG 2010 or equivalent) naming Optima Cloud and its listed subsidiaries. They prefer to issue a blanket endorsement limited to the services described in the SOW rather than open-ended wording. That should be acceptable to procurement in most cases.

- Retention/Deductible: The carrier is not willing to reduce the underlying retention from $250k to $50k for the standard program without a premium adjustment or a captive arrangement. Two options:
  1) Offer an exception letter that explains carrier constraints and commits Redwood to reasonable mitigation + notice; procurement sometimes accepts this for large strategic deals with alternative risk allocation.
  2) Pass a one-time premium credit to offset the increased retention (would need Sales approval).

- Timing: Broker can provide a temporary COI reflecting the Additional Insured (subject to underwriter sign-off) by EOD today if we confirm the exact Additional Insured wording and list of Optima entities. Formal endorsement can follow within 7-10 business days.

Next steps I recommend: Lauren to confirm the exact legal name(s) Optima wants on the endorsement and whether procurement will accept a temporary COI + exception letter for the retention. If procurement insists on a retention cap, Sales should confirm whether to cover the premium delta.

Ben Carter
